name: vertical-progressive-carousel
blurb: Vertical carousel with progress bars and auto-advance controls.
description: Context-based carousel variant displaying slides vertically. Uses ProgressSlider with vertical={true} orientation. Includes progress indicator buttons and auto-advance on configurable duration.
use_when: Displaying vertically-stacked content like testimonials or narrative steps with progress tracking.
avoid_when: Wide content galleries—vertical layout severely constrains display area.
a11y: Progress bar buttons have role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow. Arrow keys navigate vertically. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
